_comment: Counterpart of tasks-leader-fake.json: requests the System leader should answer or do ITSELF. No scenario needs evidence from the machine, so any investigator call is over-delegation (gate: 0 calls). Used to check that a delegation reminder does not make the leader delegate everything. The other faked agents (summariser, helper, linux_admin) are not gated: read fake.calls. Run with bench.py --fake <url>.

tasks.prompt: What does HTTP status code 409 mean? One sentence.
How many seconds are there in 3 days? Give the number.
Explain in two sentences the difference between a hard link and a symbolic link.
Create a file named notes.txt in the current directory containing exactly the line `hello bench`, then tell me its name.
Reply with the single word: ready
